headline:
Clocks Went Back Sunday
A Look At Your Smoke Alarms
titan_line: Echo, the clocks went back last Sunday, and fire safety groups use that weekend to remind people about smoke alarms.
rows: Press the test button on each alarm once a month. The fire department asks people to do this.
A chirp means the battery is low. Swap it right away, like the fire department teaches.
A licensed electrician can look at hard-wired alarms that act up.
echo_line: I pressed mine. It beeped back like it had been waiting all year.
source: National Fire Protection Association (NFPA), Change Your Clock, Change Your Battery · seen October 30, 2026
disclaimer: General home information, not an inspection or advice about any home. Ask your local fire department about yours.
